title: Minimal Luxury lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Minimal Luxury templates were built and verified in: lower third, monogram end card, price card, collection title, light sweep (gleam through a text mask), attribute row, framed word and slow dip.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 luxury template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.

comps: ML Light sweep (120 f, text mask + gradient)

carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp except ML Slow dip has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (mlt_, mme_, mpc_, mct_, mls_, mar_, mfr_, mdp_).
Light sweep mask: the Wordmark text is the mask (isMask) and the Gold fill rectangle its target; mask.make takes the FIRST id as the mask.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/minimal_luxury_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, run mask.make + parent.clear for MASKS, then edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
